The real handler run_income_valuation (handlers.real.ts:2550, Wave 3) covers both calculations. After wiring, both handleDirectCap and handleGrm route through POST /pilot/invoke → ToolRunner gates → backend. Second fabric-corrected route.
note_on_grm_input: The user-supplied Gross Rent Multiplier input was removed. The old calculation was user_grm * monthlyRent (arbitrary multiplier). The fabric-correct version returns a market-informed grossIncomeMultiplier from backend data. This is more honest: the backend derives the multiplier from Benton County market data, not an arbitrary user value.
